summary: Segment Routing over IPv6 describes paths as sequences of segments, advertised by protocols like BGP, IS-IS, and OSPFv3. This document extends BGP Link State to advertise SRv6 segments along with their behaviors and attributes. It is similar to BGP-LS for SR over MPLS in RFC 9085.

eli5.summary: This lets a network share its map, including the special SRv6 stops, with a central planner that decides routes.

questions: advertise srv6 segments bgp link state
